EL MONTE, Calif., Nov. 27, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- GigaCloud Technology Inc (Nasdaq: GCT) (“GigaCloud” or the “Company”), a pioneer of global end-to-end B2B technology solutions for large parcel merchandise, today announced that Erica Wei, its Chief Financial Officer, will participate in two investor conferences in December.

UBS 30th Annual Global Technology and AI Conference 2026

  • December 2, 2026 – Scottsdale, Arizona.
  • One-one-one investor meetings.

ROTH 15th Annual Deer Valley Event

  • December 10-11, 2026 – Park City, Utah.
  • One-one-one investor meetings.

Investors wishing to schedule a meeting with GigaCloud should contact their UBS or ROTH representative, respectively, or PondelWilkinson at tkehrli@pondel.com.

About GigaCloud Technology Inc

GigaCloud Technology Inc is a pioneer of global end-to-end B2B technology solutions for large parcel merchandise. The Company’s B2B ecommerce platform, which it refers to as the “GigaCloud Marketplace,” integrates everything from discovery and payments to logistics tools into one easy-to-use platform. The Company’s global marketplace seamlessly connects manufacturers, primarily in Asia, with resellers, primarily in the U.S., Asia and Europe, to execute cross-border transactions with confidence, speed and efficiency. The Company offers a truly comprehensive solution that transports products from the manufacturer’s warehouse to the end customer’s doorstep, all at one fixed price. The Company first launched its marketplace in January 2019 by focusing on the global furniture market and has since expanded into additional categories such as home appliances and fitness equipment. Aggregate cash dividend of up to an estimated $275.7 million, or an estimated up to $3.6095 per share

CAMBRIDGE, Mass., Nov. 27, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- Fulcrum Therapeutics, Inc. (“Fulcrum”) (Nasdaq: FULC) today announced that its Board of Directors has declared a special cash dividend (the “Pre-Closing Cash Dividend”) in connection with the previously announced merger (the “Merger”) with Slate Medicines, Inc. (“Slate”) pursuant to the Agreement and Plan of Merger, dated August 16, 2026 (the “Merger Agreement”). The Pre-Closing Cash Dividend, which Fulcrum estimates will be an aggregate of up to approximately $275.7 million, or up to an estimated $3.6095 per share, will be payable in cash to holders of record of outstanding shares of Fulcrum common stock as of December 7, 2026. The estimated cash dividend is equal in the aggregate to an amount mutually agreed in good faith by Fulcrum and Slate by reference to the amount by which Fulcrum’s Net Cash (as determined pursuant to the Merger Agreement) is expected to exceed $20,300,000 as of the closing of the Merger. The estimated per share dividend is based on 76,381,948 shares of common stock outstanding as of November 25, 2026. The total actual distribution of the amount of the Pre-Closing Cash Dividend is scheduled to be paid to Fulcrum’s transfer agent on December 10, 2026 (the “Dividend Payment Date”), and may be higher or lower than the estimated amount. The transfer agent will distribute the Pre-Closing Cash Dividend to stockholders within a few days following the Dividend Payment Date.

Payment of the Pre-Closing Cash Dividend is subject to the final determination of Fulcrum’s Net Cash in accordance with the Merger Agreement. The estimated aggregate Pre-Closing Cash Dividend amount includes approximately $7.0 million of proceeds from the sale of Fulcrum’s early-stage fetal hemoglobin (“HbF”) assets to an unaffiliated third-party pharmaceutical company, which are expected to be funded into escrow prior to the closing of the Merger and credited to Fulcrum’s Net Cash for purposes of the Merger Agreement. The closing of the early-stage HbF assets sale is contingent upon consummation of the Merger (or in the event the Merger Agreement is terminated, upon receipt of any necessary approvals). If the anticipated $7.0 million of proceeds are not funded into escrow, the Pre-Closing Cash Dividend will be reduced to an estimated aggregate of $268.7 million, or an estimated $3.5178 per share. Closing of the Merger is expected to occur on or about December 11, 2026, assuming that the transaction is approved by Fulcrum’s stockholders and the satisfaction or waiver of all conditions under the Merger Agreement. Fulcrum’s stockholders will consider and vote upon approval of the Merger at the special meeting of Fulcrum’s stockholders scheduled for 9:00 a.m. Eastern Time on December 3, 2026.

If you need assistance voting your shares or have questions regarding the special meeting of Fulcrum’s stockholders, please contact Fulcrum’s proxy solicitor, D.F. King & Co., Inc., at (800) 431-9643 (toll-free).

About Slate Medicines, Inc.

Slate Medicines is developing next-generation therapeutics designed to expand treatment options for migraine and other headache disorders. Slate’s mission is to offer migraine patients more complete freedom from their disease than is possible with the current standard of care. Slate is advancing a portfolio of potentially best-in-class therapeutics, led by SLTE-1009, a clinical stage anti-PACAP/VIP monoclonal antibody designed to enable subcutaneous, infrequent dosing. For more information, please visit www.slatemedicines.com. 

About Fulcrum Therapeutics, Inc.

Fulcrum Therapeutics is a clinical-stage biopharmaceutical company that focused on developing small molecules to improve the lives of patients with rare hematological disorders. Fulcrum used proprietary technology to identify drug targets that can modulate gene expression to treat the known root cause of genetically defined diseases. For more information, visit www.fulcrumtx.com and follow it on X (@FulcrumTx) and LinkedIn.

Conversion eliminates more than $400,000 in annual interest expense as nine-month net sales rise 146% to a record

SCOTTSDALE, Ariz., Nov. 27, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- Trutankless®, Inc. (OTC: TKLS), the Company known for its GEN3-series of smart electric tankless water heaters, today announced that its noteholders have converted approximately $5,000,000 in notes into equity. The conversion eliminates more than $400,000 in annual interest expense on the notes. Additional details are included in a Current Report on Form 8-K that the Company filed with the U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission on November 24, 2026.

The conversion builds on prior debt-to-equity conversions, including approximately $3 million in April 2024, and continues the Company's plan to strengthen its capital structure while aligning investors with the growth of the brand. For plumbing technicians and wholesale partners, that means a manufacturer with more room to invest in inventory, training and support.

The conversion comes as demand accelerates. The Company reported that net sales for the nine months ended September 30, 2026, rose 146% to a record $1,841,929, compared to $748,491 for the same period in 2025. Third quarter net sales grew 62% year over year to $362,790.

Trutankless® continues to expand its wholesale distribution partner network and contractor relationships nationwide, with particularly strong momentum in Arizona, Texas and Florida. Its 14,000-square-foot North Phoenix facility, opened in October 2025, brings production, engineering, installer training and distribution under one roof. In April, it launched the GEN3 Commercial 208V unit, engineered for condominiums, multi-family housing, salons, restaurants, fitness studios and other light commercial settings.

GEN3+, the next generation of the Trutankless® smart electric tankless water heater, is now in production and shipping. The wireless connected unit works with the Trutankless® connected app for homeowners and the Trutankless® Pro app and Pro dashboard for plumbing professionals, all now in beta. The Company plans to share full GEN3+ details in December.

"This conversion strengthens our balance sheet and lets us put more of our resources behind growth," said Guy Newman, CEO of Trutankless®. "Nine-month sales are up 146%, our distributor and contractor network keeps growing, and our Phoenix facility gives us room to scale. With GEN3+ now shipping and our Pro app and Pro dashboard in beta, we are giving plumbing professionals the tools to support every system they install."

About Trutankless®

Trutankless® is the premier brand in electric tankless water heating. The award-winning brand's GEN3 and GEN3+ lineup delivers endless, on-demand hot water in a sleek, space-saving design for homes, condos, multi-family and light commercial spaces.

The Trutankless® connected app is designed to put performance insights and preventative maintenance alerts in the hands of homeowners and plumbing pros, keeping every system running at peak performance, maximizing energy efficiency and extending its service life.

Trutankless® products are sold through plumbing wholesale distributors and dealers nationwide. Founded in 2008, Trutankless®, Inc. (OTC: TKLS) is headquartered in Scottsdale, Arizona. Learn more at www.trutankless.com.

WEST HOLLYWOOD, Calif., Nov. 27, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- VisionWave Holdings, Inc. (NASDAQ: VWAV) (the “Company”), a technology company focused on advanced defense, autonomous systems and related technologies, today announced the closing of its previously announced registered direct offering with institutional investors for the purchase and sale of approximately $2.0 million of shares of Common Stock (or pre-funded warrants in lieu thereof) together with accompanying investor warrants at a price of $0.19 per Common Unit.

The offering consisted of the sale of 10,526,313 Common Units (or Pre-Funded Units), each consisting of (i) one (1) share of Common Stock or one (1) Pre-Funded Warrant and (ii) one (1) Registered Common Warrant to purchase one (1) share of Common Stock per warrant at an exercise price of $0.57. The public offering price per Common Unit was $0.19 (or $0.18 for each Pre-Funded Unit, which is equal to the public offering price per Common Unit sold in the offering minus an exercise price of $0.01 per Pre-Funded Warrant). The Pre-Funded Warrants are immediately exercisable and may be exercised at any time until exercised in full. For each Pre-Funded Unit sold in the offering, the number of Common Units in the offering was decreased on a one-for-one basis. The initial exercise price of each Common Warrant is $0.57 per share of Common Stock or pursuant to an alternative cashless exercise option. The Common Warrants are exercisable immediately and expire 60 months after the initial issuance date.

Aggregate gross proceeds to the Company were approximately $2.0 million. The Company expects to use the net proceeds from the offering, together with its existing cash, for general corporate purposes, including partial repayment of the convertible debenture issued by the Company to YA II PN, Ltd. in the original principal amount of $10,000,000 on July 20, 2026 and working capital.

Following the closing of the offering, and after the exercise in full of the Pre-Funded Warrants issued in the offering and the issuance of 9,313,157 shares of Common Stock upon the exercise of certain Common Warrants, the Company has 41,260,663 shares of Common Stock issued and outstanding.

The Company has agreed not to issue shares of Common Stock under its standby equity purchase agreement for 30 days following the closing of the offering, and its outstanding convertible notes may not be converted during that period.

Aegis Capital Corp. acted as exclusive placement agent for the offering. Sheppard, Mullin, Richter & Hampton LLP acted as counsel to the Company. Kaufman & Canoles, P.C. acted as counsel to Aegis Capital Corp.

The registered direct offering was made pursuant to an effective shelf registration statement on Form S-3 (No. 333-297939) previously filed with the U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission (SEC) and declared effective by the SEC on September 1, 2026. Vancouver, British Columbia, Nov. 27, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- NevGold Corp. (TSX-V: NAU) (OTCQX:NAUFF) (Frankfurt:5E50) (“NevGold” or the “Company“) is pleased to announce that the Company will graduate from the TSX Venture Exchange to the senior board Toronto Stock Exchange (the “TSX”) and the common shares of the Company will commence trading on the TSX at the opening of the market on or about December 1, 2026 under its current symbol “NAU”.

CEO, Brandon Bonifacio states “Since forming NevGold and completing our public listing in 2021, we have transformed the Company from an early-stage explorer into a well-funded developer with a portfolio of highly prospective gold, antimony, and copper assets in the Western United States. Our graduation to the TSX from the TSX Venture Exchange is a significant achievement that reflects the hard work of our team and the substantial progress we have made in building shareholder value.

Listing on Canada’s premier senior exchange represents an important milestone in NevGold’s evolution and positions the Company for its next phase of growth. We expect the TSX listing to increase our visibility among institutional and retail investors globally, expand access to capital, and further enhance our standing within the investment community.

As we continue advancing our flagship projects, particularly at a time when domestic sources of critical minerals such as antimony are becoming increasingly strategic, we remain committed to executing our long-term growth strategy and progressing toward becoming a leading emerging gold and antimony producer in North America.”

The Company has received final approval from the TSX for the listing of its common shares. In connection with the listing, the common shares will be voluntarily delisted from the TSX Venture Exchange upon the commencement of trading on the main TSX board.

The Company’s trading symbol will remain “NAU” upon the commencement of trading on the main TSX board. The CUSIP and ISIN will also remain unchanged. Shareholders are not required to take any action in connection with the Company’s graduation to the TSX, and existing share certificates and direct registration statements will continue to represent Nevgold’s common shares.

In connection with the listing on the TSX, the Company has reconstituted its audit committee to consist of Victor Bradley, Sean Waller and Scott Bensing, each of which is independent as determined under National Instrument 52-110 – Audit Committees. Victor Bradley has been appointed as the lead independent director of the Company.

NevGold is dedicated to discovering, de-risking, and rapidly advancing gold and critical metals projects across premier jurisdictions in Nevada and Idaho to drive shareholder value and strengthen US mineral security. The Company holds a 100% interest in the Limousine Butte (gold-antimony) and Cedar Wash (gold) projects in Nevada, and the Nutmeg Mountain (gold) and Zeus (copper) projects in Idaho. BROOKFIELD, NEWS, Nov. 27, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- Brookfield Renewable Partners L.P. (“BEP”) (NYSE: BEP; TSX: BEP.UN) today announced updates to the plan of arrangement to advance the proposed corporate simplification (the “Simplification”) and declared its quarterly distribution.

In light of the expected benefits of the Simplification to all unitholders and approximately 62% of units voted to date with 99.7% of votes cast in favour, the BEP limited partnership agreement (“LPA”) and plan of arrangement were amended to facilitate completion of the Simplification. 

The amended plan of arrangement now requires approval by two-thirds of votes cast by Unitholders rather than approval by holders of two-thirds of all eligible units. Unitholders will no longer be required to vote on amendments to the BEP LPA and all other substantive terms of the plan of arrangement, including the tax implications and expected benefits for investors, have been retained.

Unitholders who have already submitted a proxy or voting instruction form do not need to vote again.

The deadline for registered unitholders to cast their votes by proxy will now be 5:00 p.m. (Toronto time) on December 7, 2026 with the Unitholders’ Meeting being held virtually on December 9, 2026 at 10:00 a.m. (Toronto time).

The quarterly distribution for BEP will be paid on December 21, 2026 to holders of record at the close of business on December 8, 2026, and it is expected that the Simplification will be completed by the end of 2026.

Corporate Simplification Details

Following an amendment to the BEP limited partnership agreement, the Simplification will now be completed pursuant to the terms of an amended plan of arrangement (the “Arrangement”). Upon receipt of approval from BEP unitholders of the Simplification, all outstanding limited partnership units of BEP, other than preferred units, will, together with certain related exchangeable securities, be exchanged on a one-for-one basis for newly issued shares of Brookfield Renewable Partners Inc. (“BEP Inc.”).

Shareholders of Brookfield Renewable Corporation (“BEPC”) have already approved the Simplification, pursuant to which their class A exchangeable subordinate voting shares will be exchanged for new shares of BEP Inc. on a one-for-one basis.

Benefits of a Simplified Structure

Brookfield Renewable expects the Simplification to be tax-deferred for Canadian and U.S. investors and completed without any meaningful cost to the business, while providing securityholders with the following benefits, among others:

  • Improved consolidated trading liquidity through a single listed security;
  • Increased demand from current indices and potential additional index inclusion;
  • Stronger alignment with long-term capital allocation trends toward indexable and ETF-eligible corporate securities;
  • Simplified investor analysis, screening, and benchmarking through a single listed reporting entity;
  • Broader access to a larger pool of investors who prefer corporate structures;
  • Enhanced governance framework and voting rights for public securityholders; and
  • For BEP unitholders, elimination of onerous partnership tax reporting forms and preferential dividend tax rates for many Canadian and U.S. taxable investors.

The Simplification will be implemented by way of a court-approved plan of arrangement and will be subject to customary regulatory approvals for a transaction of this nature, including approval for the listing of BEP Inc.’s shares on the New York Stock Exchange and Toronto Stock Exchange.

There will be no change to Brookfield’s ownership of Brookfield Renewable as a result of the Simplification. BEP’s preferred units and public debt will remain outstanding and unaffected by the Simplification.

The Board of Directors of BEP, based in part on the unanimous recommendation of its nominating and governance committee (consisting entirely of independent directors) and the fairness opinion previously received from Scotiabank, unanimously affirmed the conclusion that the Simplification, as amended, is in the best interests of BEP, and have unanimously resolved to approve the Simplification and recommend that BEP unitholders vote in favour of the Simplification.

Torys LLP is acting as legal advisor to Brookfield Renewable for the Simplification.

Scotiabank is acting as independent financial advisor, and Goodmans LLP is acting as independent legal counsel to the nominating and governance committees of each of BEP and BEPC in connection with the Simplification.

Further information regarding the Simplification, including details on the vote that will be required, will be contained in a disclosure supplement that will be available later today. Copies of the supplement, the arrangement agreement amendment, the amended plan of arrangement and certain related documents will be filed with the applicable Canadian securities regulators and with the United States Securities and Exchange Commission and will be available on SEDAR+ at https://sedarplus.ca and on EDGAR at https://sec.gov.

Please note that BEP has applied for exemptive relief from the Ontario Securities Commission in order to not require further approval by the holders of class A shares of Brookfield Renewable Partners Inc. (“BEP Inc. Class A Shares”) for any future distributions of BEP Inc. Class A Shares or securities that are, directly or indirectly, convertible into, or exercisable or exchangeable for, BEP Inc. Class A Shares under a prospectus, conditional upon obtaining the required securityholder approvals described in the joint management information circular (as supplemented). Accordingly, (i) in respect of BEPC, a vote in favour of the Simplification by BEPC shareholders constituted a vote in favour of BEP Inc.’s ability to conduct future issuances of BEP Inc. Class A Shares or securities that are, directly or indirectly, convertible into, or exercisable or exchangeable for, BEP Inc. Class A Shares pursuant to a prospectus, and (ii) in respect of BEP, a vote in favour of the Simplification by BEP unitholders will constitute a vote in favour of BEP Inc.’s ability to conduct future issuances of BEP Inc. Class A Shares or securities that are, directly or indirectly, convertible into, or exercisable or exchangeable for, BEP Inc. Class A Shares pursuant to a prospectus, in each case, without requiring further approval by holders of BEP Inc. Class A Shares in accordance with National Instrument 41-101 – General Prospectus Requirements.

Distribution Declaration and Update on Distribution Reinvestment Plan

The Q4 2026 quarterly distribution by BEP in the amount of $0.392 per LP unit will be payable on December 21, 2026 to unitholders of record as at the close of business on December 8, 2026. In conjunction with BEP’s distribution declaration, the Board of Directors of BEPC has declared an equivalent dividend of $0.392 per BEPC share, also payable on December 21, 2026 to shareholders of record as at the close of business on December 8, 2026. It is expected that the Simplification will be completed in December 2026, following the payment of distributions and dividends on December 21, 2026.

As a result of the expected timing of completion of the Simplification, BEP’s distribution reinvestment plan will be terminated effective November 27, 2026. The final distribution of BEP units under the plan was made in respect of BEP’s distribution paid on September 29, 2026 to unitholders of record as of August 31, 2026. Participants will receive the December 21, 2026 distribution in cash.

BEP Inc. expects to adopt a dividend reinvestment plan for the BEP Inc. Class A Shares that is substantially similar to BEP’s plan. Registered unitholders who currently participate in BEP’s distribution reinvestment plan will be required to confirm their enrolment in the BEP Inc. plan by June 21, 2027, and non-registered holders should contact their broker or other intermediary.

Brookfield Renewable operates one of the world’s largest publicly traded platforms for renewable power and sustainable solutions. Our renewable power portfolio consists of hydroelectric, wind, utility-scale solar, distributed solar and storage facilities and our sustainable solutions assets include our investment in a leading global nuclear services business and a portfolio of investments in carbon capture and storage capacity, agricultural renewable natural gas, materials recycling and eFuels manufacturing capacity, among others.

A new feature inside Dentrix and Ascend by Dentrix automatically charts early-stage cavity treatment and includes drill-free Curodont® Repair Fluoride Plus as a treatment option.

ZUG, Switzerland--(BUSINESS WIRE)--vVARDIS (NYSE: VVVV), the Swiss healthcare company in the dental med-tech sector offering non-invasive treatment for early-stage cavities, and Henry Schein One, a global leader in dental technology, today announced the launch of clinical auto-charting functionality for clinicians documenting early-stage cavities.

When a clinician detects an early-stage cavity, auto-charting features in Dentrix and Ascend record the code in the patient's chart with one click, reducing the charting process by 86%. The care team can then choose Curodont® to treat the tooth during the same visit, without duplicate documentation and with access to patient education resources regarding Curodont® within the platform. Throughout this workflow, treatment planning and decisions remain solely at the discretion of the clinician and patient.

The launch will represent the next phase of the collaboration between vVARDIS and Henry Schein One, which earlier this year introduced in-software awareness of Curodont® Repair Fluoride Plus to practices that use Dentrix and Ascend across the United States.

Tooth decay is the world’s most prevalent non-communicable disease, affecting approximately 2.5 billion people globally.1 A recent population-based cohort study in the U.S. associates untreated cavities with a 26 percent increased risk of all-cause mortality and a 48 percent increase in heart-disease mortality.2 Curodont® is designed as a non-invasive treatment intended to arrest or reverse early-stage cavities without drilling. Since its U.S. commercial launch in January 2024, vVARDIS estimates that Curodont® Repair Fluoride Plus has been used to treat over 3.5 million teeth and has been sold to over 20,000 of the approximately 110,000 general dental practices in the U.S., as of June 30, 2026.3

"Finding an early cavity and treating it should be one workflow, not two," said Haley Abivardi, DMD, co-CEO and co-founder of vVARDIS. “Dental teams want accurate information about their options for early-stage cavities, and patients want to understand the treatment they receive. This new functionality is another example of how technology is helping to create more efficiency in dental practices.”

"Our vision for Dentrix and Ascend is to bring intelligence directly into the clinical workflow, supporting clinicians without adding complexity. Auto-charting for the treatment of early-stage cavities is a great example of how we are connecting clinical insights, AI imaging, and documentation in a one click workflow to make technology work more simply for the dental team,” said April Lowry, Executive Director and General Manager, Clinical and AI, Henry Schein One.

This partnership promises to streamline access to drill-free dental solutions for patients across the United States.

“Dentrix and Ascend are part of the daily workflow for tens of thousands of U.S. practices,” said Greg Smith, Senior Vice President and General Manager, North America, vVARDIS. “We’re pleased to work with Henry Schein One to make information about Curodont® and drill-free treatment options for early-stage cavities more accessible to dental practices.”

Availability

Dentrix and Ascend are used in more than 75,000 locations in the United States. Auto-charting and the in-software Curodont® content are expected to become available within the next 30 days. vVARDIS and Henry Schein One plan to demonstrate the integration at the Greater New York Dental Meeting in New York City, November 29 to December 2, 2026.

About vVARDIS

vVARDIS (NYSE: VVVV) is a Swiss healthcare company in the dental med-tech sector headquartered in Zug, Switzerland, founded by Drs. Haley and Goly Abivardi, sisters, internationally renowned dentists and serial entrepreneurs. The company’s proprietary Curodont® technology platform offers an early therapeutic solution for tooth decay. Its flagship products are based on proprietary, peptide-containing formulations that complement the patient’s natural biology to help it stop the progression of early-stage cavities, preserve natural tooth structure and repair damaged enamel in early-stage cavities. Curodont®’s underlying technology is supported by a body of scientific evidence accumulated over the last 25 years, published in more than 250 publications, including randomized controlled trials, systematic reviews, meta-analyses and long-term real-world cohort analyses. Curodont® is featured in the curricula of over 50 U.S. and European dental programs. For more information, visit www.vVARDIS.com and ww.linkedin.com/company/vvardis.

Henry Schein One, a global leader in dental technology, empowers dentists to focus on patient care and helps to ensure practice success. With simple and integrated technology, practices become more efficient, profitable, and connected—leading to better experiences for patients and care teams alike. The company’s comprehensive portfolio spans demand generation, patient experience, practice management, revenue cycle, analytics, and clinical workflow.

Key Terms

non-communicable diseasemedical
Non-communicable diseases are health conditions that are not passed between people, typically developing slowly and lasting a long time—think chronic wear-and-tear illnesses like heart disease, diabetes, and most cancers rather than a contagious cold. They matter to investors because they drive sustained demand for drugs, medical devices, long-term care and insurance, influence healthcare costs and policy, and can create predictable revenue opportunities or risks across healthcare and consumer sectors.
all-cause mortalitymedical
All-cause mortality is the total number of deaths from any cause within a defined group over a specific time period. For investors, it is a broad safety and outcome measure used in clinical trials and public-health studies—like counting everyone who leaves a club for any reason—because higher or lower all-cause mortality can influence regulatory decisions, product reputation, long-term liability and market value.
cohort studymedical
A cohort study follows a specific group of people who share a common trait (like exposure to a drug or treatment) over time to see how many develop a particular outcome, such as a health effect. For investors, cohort studies matter because they provide real-world evidence about a product’s safety, effectiveness or market need—think of tracking a cohort like watching a neighborhood over years to see who adopts a new service and whether it works as promised.
randomized controlled trialsmedical
Randomized controlled trials are studies where participants are randomly assigned to receive either a new treatment or a comparison (such as a standard treatment or placebo), so outcomes can be fairly compared like flipping a coin to decide teams. For investors, they matter because they provide the most reliable evidence about whether a drug, device or intervention actually works and is safe, which influences regulatory approval, market demand and the financial outlook of companies developing them.
meta-analysesmedical
A meta-analysis is a research method that combines and statistically pools the results of multiple independent studies that address the same question, producing a single summary estimate of effect (for example, treatment benefit or risk). It increases precision by weighting studies according to size and variance, but its conclusions depend on the quality and compatibility of the included studies and can be distorted by differences between studies (heterogeneity) or by publication and selection biases.

As previously disclosed, the Reserved Capital Increase forms part of the corporate steps being taken by the Company in connection with its request for review of the New York Stock Exchange (“NYSE”) delisting determination filed on September 10, 2026.

Delegated Rights Issues. The Meeting granted the Board of Directors authority, pursuant to Article 2443 of the Italian Civil Code, to increase the share capital for consideration, in cash, on a divisible basis, on one or more occasions, by June 30, 2027, through two separate rights issues to be offered on a pre-emptive basis to those entitled thereto:

The Delegated Rights Issue and the Delegated Rights Issue for Minorities both presuppose the successful completion of the Reserved Capital Increase and are independent and non-alternative: the Board of Directors may exercise either or both of the authorities, depending on the Company’s capital strengthening needs, market conditions and the progress of the restructuring process.

Key Terms

pre-emptive rightsfinancial
An investor's pre-emptive rights are the option given to existing shareholders to buy new shares before they are offered to the public or new investors, letting them maintain their percentage ownership and voting power. Think of it like a right of first refusal at a sale: it prevents ownership from being diluted by allowing current holders to keep the same stake, which matters because dilution can reduce influence and the share of future profits.
share premiumfinancial
Share premium is the extra amount investors pay when a company issues new shares above the shares’ stated face (par) value — like paying more than a ticket’s face price because it’s in demand. It matters to investors because that extra money becomes part of the company’s equity, strengthening the balance sheet without adding debt and signaling market interest; it can also be used for certain corporate actions such as buybacks or covering issuance costs.
equity reservefinancial
A portion of a company’s shareholders’ equity that is set aside for a specific purpose and not available for ordinary dividend payments. Equity reserves arise from transactions or accounting rules—examples include share premium from issuing stock above par, revaluation gains, legal or statutory reserves, and stock‑based compensation reserves—and act like a labeled bucket within owners’ equity that affects how much profit can be distributed and how ownership or book values are reported.
american depositary sharefinancial
An American Depositary Share (ADS) is a U.S.-listed certificate that represents a specified number of shares in a foreign company, held by a custodian bank; it works like a receipt that allows U.S. investors to buy and trade foreign equity on American exchanges without dealing with another country’s markets. Investors care because ADSs make foreign stocks easier to access, improve liquidity and settlement in dollars, and can affect dividend payments, voting rights and regulatory oversight compared with buying the underlying foreign shares directly.

TORONTO, Nov. 27, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- MDA Space Ltd. (TSX: MDA) (NYSE: MDA) (the "Company"), a trusted mission partner to the rapidly expanding global defence and space industry, today announced that it has completed its previously announced acquisition of Blue Canyon Technologies (BCT) LLC, a U.S.-based spacecraft and satellite component manufacturer and mission services provider, formerly part of RTX.

BCT brings 400 highly skilled employees in the Denver, Colorado space and aerospace hub, and more than 95 spacecraft launched and 4,300 products on orbit. Its addition to MDA Space provides the company with a strategic business and manufacturing footprint to capitalize on growing demand in the U.S. government market for defence space missions. With the close of the acquisition, BCT will be rebranded as MDA Space and operate as MDA Space USA. 

"I want to welcome the Blue Canyon Technologies team to MDA Space. The addition of BCT to MDA Space adds a strong and established business and team with domestic manufacturing capability that is ideally positioned to accelerate our growth strategy in the expanding U.S. defence market," said Mike Greenley, CEO of MDA Space. "Securing these strategic benefits on an accretive basis with a profitable and cash-generating business makes this an ideal fit for MDA Space global expansion and continued shareholder value creation."
